context.description: Testcontainers for Go is a Go package that makes it simple to create and clean up container-based dependencies for automated integration/smoke tests. The clean, easy-to-use API enables developers to programmatically define containers that should be run as part of a test and clean up those resources when the test is done.

signals.title: fix: return reaper handshake errors
signals.text: This supersedes #3828. The original PR was automatically closed after I accidentally deleted my fork ## Related issues - Closes #3827 ## What does this PR do? This PR makes `Reaper.connect` perform the Ryuk handshake synchronously before returning a successful connection. If the handshake fails, the connection is closed and the handshake error is returned to the caller. The existing retry path can then handle the failure instead of treating the reaper connection as successful. It also adds a regression test using a local TCP listener that returns an invalid ACK, verifying that `connect` returns an error and no termination channel. ## Why is it important? Previously, handshake failures were only logged inside the connection goroutine. `Reaper.connect` still returned a non-nil termination channel and nil error, so callers could believe the reaper was connected even though Ryuk had rejected or failed the handshake. Returning the error makes reaper startup failures visible and retryable. ## How to test this PR ```shell go test ./ -run "TestReaperConnectReturnsHandshakeError|TestSpawnerRetryError|TestSpawnerBackoff"
signals.author: drawliin

Release notes

Sourced from github.com/moby/go-archive's releases.

v0.3.0

Security

This release fixes CVE-2026-17106 / GHSA-hfg8-hc9c-6c3h, where a crafted tar archive could use links to cause extraction operations to create or overwrite files outside the intended destination directory.

The issue affected Unpack, UnpackLayer, Untar, UntarUncompressed, and the ApplyLayer helpers. Users should upgrade and avoid extracting untrusted archives with earlier versions.

What's Changed

  • archive: harden tar extraction against path traversal moby/go-archive#45
  • archive: do not follow reparse points in chtimes moby/go-archive#90
  • archive: fix creation time updates on Windows moby/go-archive#79
  • archive: minor cleanups and godoc touch-up moby/go-archive#87
  • archive: RebaseArchiveEntries: fix archive path rebasing moby/go-archive#43

Test and CI changes

  • ci: enable dependabot for actions moby/go-archive#81
  • archive: make breakoutErr unwrap its cause moby/go-archive#91
  • archive: use filepath for filesystem paths in tests moby/go-archive#80
  • archive: use filepath for filesystem paths in tests moby/go-archive#80

Full Changelog: https://github.com/moby/go-archive/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0

v0.2.1

What's Changed

  • reject out-of-range device numbers in layer moby/go-archive#36
  • createImpliedDirectories: fix directory detection and path handling moby/go-archive#44
  • createImpliedDirectories: honor NoLchown for implied directories moby/go-archive#70
  • createTarFile: use switch for timestamp updates moby/go-archive#67
  • drop redundant ExcludePatterns initialization moby/go-archive#62
  • ExportChanges: use POSIX / Unix conventions for Tar operations moby/go-archive#41
  • getInodeFromStat: return error on failure moby/go-archive#50
  • overlayWhiteoutConverter.ConvertRead: avoid redundant chown moby/go-archive#55
  • overlayWhiteoutConverter.ConvertWrite: explicitly use POSIX / Unix moby/go-archive#38
  • overlayWhiteoutConverter.ConvertWrite: simplify directory check moby/go-archive#34
  • overlayWhiteoutConverter: fixes and cleanups moby/go-archive#52
  • RebaseArchiveEntries: use POSIX / Unix paths moby/go-archive#42
  • tarAppender.addTarFile: normalize archivePath to POSIX moby/go-archive#40
  • tarAppender.addTarFile: return error before writing header moby/go-archive#51
  • TarOptions: document IncludeFiles, ExcludePatterns moby/go-archive#61
  • Unpack: prevent nil-pointer if nil-options are passed moby/go-archive#66
  • remove some intermediate vars moby/go-archive#53
  • rename some vars to prevent shadowing "path" import moby/go-archive#35

signal.title: fix: return reaper handshake errors
signal.text: This supersedes #3828. The original PR was automatically closed after I accidentally deleted my fork ## Related issues - Closes #3827 ## What does this PR do? This PR makes `Reaper.connect` perform the Ryuk handshake synchronously before returning a successful connection. If the handshake fails, the connection is closed and the handshake error is returned to the caller. The existing retry path can then handle the failure instead of treating the reaper connection as successful. It also adds a regression test using a local TCP listener that returns an invalid ACK, verifying that `connect` returns an error and no termination channel. ## Why is it important? Previously, handshake failures were only logged inside the connection goroutine. `Reaper.connect` still returned a non-nil termination channel and nil error, so callers could believe the reaper was connected even though Ryuk had rejected or failed the handshake. Returning the error makes reaper startup failures visible and retryable. ## How to test this PR ```shell go test ./ -run "TestReaperConnectReturnsHandshakeError|TestSpawnerRetryError|TestSpawnerBackoff"
